title: Test command cannot import the demo module

summary.text: The test command exited with code 1 and reported ModuleNotFoundError for demo.

task_goal.text: Run the project's test suite and report whether it passes.

expected_behavior.text: The test runner should be able to import the project's modules. Whether all tests are expected to pass needs confirmation.

actual_behavior.text: python -m unittest returned exit code 1 with FAILED (errors=1): ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'demo'.

reproduction_steps.text: The recorded attempt ran python -m unittest.
Try the same command in the project environment after documenting dependency installation and the working directory. This has not been verified as a reproducible procedure.

outcome.text: No later repair or verification is recorded in the included context.

possible_causes.text: The module may be absent from the environment or outside the import search path. The error does not establish which explanation is correct.

questions_to_confirm: How was the environment prepared and which Python version was used?
Is demo a local project module or an installed dependency?
Does the same command fail again in the intended working directory?
